content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(EDR-003 Cron Job Creation With Suspicious Command Path) OR BIOC(EDR-003 Systemd Unit With Suspicious ExecStart) OR BIOC(EDR-003 Local Account Created With Sudo Group) OR BIOC(EDR-003 SSH Key Generation Then Authorized Keys Write) OR BIOC(EDR-003 Shell Profile Modified With Background Execution) STITCH BY agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id WITHIN 900s
rules.name: Linux Multi-Mechanism Persistence Installation
